initial_growth.rationale: Q2 tirzepatide revenue grew 73.3% YoY, while consolidated realized-price contribution was -13% and volume +60%; the distribution explicitly mean-reverts volume-led hypergrowth and includes material pricing/reimbursement downside.

long_run_growth_y8.rationale: Long-run franchise growth decays materially from current hypergrowth; the lower tail includes competitive/pricing pressure and proximity to major 2036/2037 compound-patent expiries on the 8Y horizon.

growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: Hypergrowth mean-reverts over several capacity/reimbursement cycles.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: Demand, reimbursement and manufacturing are shared drivers, with large product-specific safety/competition idiosyncrasy.

terminal_margin_Y5.rationale: Manufacturing capex currently equals 12.3% of revenue; Y5 center allows normalization while preserving reimbursement, R&D, litigation and launch costs.

terminal_margin_Y8.rationale: Longer-run cash margin allows increasing patent/exclusivity and portfolio-replacement pressure.

shock_sigma_meta.rationale: Quarterly pricing, channel/rebate, clinical/regulatory and manufacturing mix uncertainty.

shock_persistence_meta.rationale: Pricing/reimbursement and supply conditions persist but mean-revert.

lower_bound_meta.rationale: Severe concentration/policy downside while remaining a scaled pharma franchise.

upper_bound_meta.rationale: Prevents temporary mix/capex normalization from becoming implausibly permanent cash economics.
